_doc: Figure height (top of head/hands to lowest point) as a fraction of the 88% standing height, per frame name. First matching regex wins. Gemini ignores the prompt's scale lock, so every frame is normalised by pose instead of by raw image scale. Jump/dash/crouch values were tuned on the first Bob batch so the head size matches idle.
_pivot_doc: How pivotX (the x that sits on the fighter's position) is measured. torso: alpha centroid of the 25-70% height band. head_foot: midpoint of the head and the planted foot, for kicks where the raised leg drags the torso centroid forward and the body would visibly jump back.
